testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.datasource.postgres.PostgresConnectorTests

testcase.name: a socket timeout or an unexpected exception from the driver is a fixed-text failure()
by default only public addresses are reachable, so the platform databases are not()
driver errors are mapped by SQLSTATE and their text never travels()
the socket factory refuses to exist without a pinned address()
JSON null is a real JSON null()
the connection target holds the checked addresses and prints nothing()
the platform's own JDBC URLs yield the hosts to deny()
the string-argument form used by older driver versions pins the same way()
credential values that look like driver URL syntax are refused()
configuration is strict and TLS cannot be switched off()
a query is rejected by the guard before a connection is opened()
whatever host the driver asks for, the socket connects to the pinned address()
a denied host stays denied even when it is public or allow-listed, and aliases of it are caught by address()
a private host is reachable only through the explicit server-side allow-list()
